candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old and has fever. The fever has lasted for 2 days. The temperature measured is 38.0°C. The child has a generalized rash. There is clouding of the cornea. The child has red eyes. I did not see pus draining from the eye. The child does not have mouth ulcers. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months, and is not coughing with measles now. There is no obvious cause of fever seen. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment. The malaria risk in this area is high. Malaria test is available and the result is negative. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, diarrhoea, or ear problem. The child does not have runny nose or stiff neck.
